n = int(input())
L = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
last_killed = n - 1
killed = 0
for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
    killed += min(i, max(0, L[i] - (i - last_killed)))
    last_killed = min(last_killed, i - L[i], i - 1)
    if last_killed < 0:
        print(n - killed)
        break
else:
    print(n - killed)
